review_note: Governor's release of September 14, 2007: 'Gov. Blagojevich declared the nine counties disaster areas quickly after the storms.' No signing day is given, so the release's date is used and the storm's start is the event date.
IEMA-OHS release of August 30, 2024: the Governor 'issued a Disaster Proclamation following the severe weather and flooding' of July 13 to 16, 2024.
Proclamation signed October 26, 2023; the Governor's release of October 27 says it is 'based on the severe weather and flooding that affected Cook County on September 17'.
